**Fixture:** `bench-landing.json`  
**Source match:** Kaitlin Quevedo (host) vs Ángela Boluda (guest), clay, 2025-04-09  
**Match id:** `f6cd7d61-fc69-4dfc-8336-2c90a4ced93a`  
**Slug:** `demo-boluda-clay-2025-04-09`  
**Score:** 6-1 · 7-6 (set 2 TB 7-2)  
**Generated by:** `scripts/generate-bench-fixture.cjs`

## Source → frozen chain

| Role | Path |
|------|------|
| Raw Boluda SV tables | `shots_boluda.json` (909), `points_boluda.json` (136), `sets_boluda.json` (2), `stats_boluda.json` (180), `match_boluda.json` |
| Zod + enrich entry | `boluda.ts` (`ShotSchema` / `PointSchema` / … → `enrichShots`) |
| Frozen bench posts payload | `bench-landing.json` (~2.5 MB) — consumed by `export-bench-posts.cjs` |

`pooledShots` and `featured.shotPreview` are full-match copies (909 shots each),
not a 120-shot sample.

## Scope

The frozen fixture replicates the shape of `BenchListResponse` from the app's
`getDemoBenchListResponse()` path, plus post-only enrichments. It contains:

- `aggregates` — ticker counts (1 match / 909 shots / 136 points / 1 with video)
- `featured` — rank-1 summary with hero stats and full shot preview
- `matches` — single demo match
- `pooledShots` — all enriched shots for court plots
- `records` — four bench records (fastest serve, longest rally, best break conversion, top points won)
- v2 extras: `momentumSeries`, `patternStats`, `zoneWinRates`, `rallyBuckets`, `depthAggression`, `winnersErrors`, `stats`

## Validation notes

- **Zod gate:** source JSONs are parsed in `boluda.ts` via `MatchSchema`, `ShotSchema`, `PointSchema`, `SetSummarySchema`, `PlayerStatSchema` before enrich.
- **Identity:** match UUID and slug are stable across source, `featured`, `matches[0]`, and all four records.
- **Pool fidelity:** `len(pooledShots) === len(featured.shotPreview) === aggregates.totalShots === 909`; generated from the same Boluda enriched shot list (no downsample).
- **Serve speed filter:** plausible band 40–215 km/h keeps 131/134 serves; 3 outliers at ~224 / 244 / 252 km/h are dropped for averages/records. Fastest-serve record uses guest first serve **210.17 km/h** (bounce 1.681, 5.915).
- **Raw speed ceiling:** max shot speed in fixture is **338 km/h** — not used for serve averages; treat extreme non-serve speeds as SV noise.
- **`ended_by`:** null on all `pooledShots` rows (point-level `endedBy` lives on points / enrich join, not copied into the preview snake_case shape).
- **`shotAttribution`:** null on all source shots.
- **Direction sentinel:** 11 shots have `direction === "---"`.
- **hit_z:** one slightly negative value (−0.058 m); otherwise contact heights look plausible.
- **Feed strokes:** 2 Feed shots remain in the pool; court slides that filter by stroke should decide whether to exclude them.
- **Records snapshot:** longest rally 19 (set 2, game 18, point 111); best break conversion host 50% (7/14); top points won host 56.6%.

## Known gaps and methodology

### SV vs scorekeeper

- **Rally length** is derived from the maximum `shot_number` within each
  (set, game, point) triple. This is a SwingVision approximation — official
  scorekeeper rally counts may differ when the scorekeeper tracked a different
  shot boundary.
- **First-serve / break-point stats** prefer official match stats when present
  (via `tennis_match_stats`). When official stats are absent, rates are computed
  from vendored `@courtviz/core` functions using the shots↔points join.
- **Break-point conversion** on the break-points slide is shot-derived; the
  clutch-points slide prefers official stats. Slides are labeled accordingly.

### Outlier clip policy

- **Coordinate outliers:** ~15 shots have `hitY` beyond court bounds (≤ −3 or
  ≥ 28) and ~6 have `|bounceX|` > doubles half (5.485 m). These are SwingVision
  tracking noise on Out/Net results. Court layers clip to court bounds via
  `CourtSurface` clip paths — outliers are visually excluded but remain in the
  fixture for KPI accuracy.
- **hitY clamp risk:** ~71% of `hitY` values for the host fall in the near half
  (0–11.885) because SV records contact position from the player's perspective.
  Half-court normalization (`normalizeHit`) mirrors guest contacts so both
  players plot on the near half. Slides that do not use `useHalfCourtNormalization`
  will show guest dots on the far half only.
- **Serve speed filter:** fixture generation filters 40–215 km/h for averages
  and records. The fastest-serve slide re-maxes without the filter; fault serves
  are outlined but not separately legended (planned fix).

### Depth threshold: 5.485 vs 6.4

- `DEPTH_SHORT_MAX_M = SERVICE_BOX_DEPTH_M = NET_Y − SERVICE_LINE_NEAR = 5.485 m`
  — distance **from net** to the service line. Used by `classifyDepthFromNet`.
- `SERVICE_LINE_NEAR = 6.40 m` — distance **from near baseline** to the service
  line. This is the Y-coordinate in court meters, not the depth-from-net metric.
- Both values describe the same ITF service line; the difference is the
  measurement origin (net vs baseline). Depth bands use distance-from-net
  (5.485) so that "short" = ball bounces within the service box on either side.

### Bench records

- Records use vendored `@courtviz/core` rate functions with `total > 0` guard.
- **Serve speeds** are filtered to a plausible range of 40–215 km/h. If fewer
  than 3 serves fall in range, an IQR-based outlier cap is applied instead.
- **Longest rally** uses `max(shot_number)` per point as a proxy for rally
  length. This overcounts by 1 if the rally includes a let or serve retry, but
  is consistent with the live Bench UI.
- **Break conversion** and **points won** are computed for both host and guest;
  the record reflects the higher value across all published matches.

### Ticker counts

- `totalMatches`, `totalShots`, `totalPoints`, and `matchesWithVideo` are
  **platform-wide** counts (all matches in the database, not just published
  features). In the demo fixture these are set to 1 / 909 / 136 / 1 to match
  the single demo match.

### Records and featured

- Records and featured data are **published features only**. The demo fixture
  contains one match (Quevedo–Boluda) as both the featured story and the only
  record source.

### Featured match hero stats

- Hero stat keys: `points_won_pct`, `first_serve_pct`,
  `shot_accuracy_pct`, `avg_shot_speed`.
- Values are computed from the enriched shots and momentum points using
  `@courtviz/core` rate functions, matching the live Bench UI exactly.
- **v2 changes:** `break_points_converted_pct` and `total_shots` hero stats
  were replaced with `shot_accuracy_pct` and `avg_shot_speed` to support the
  court-plot–first storytelling format.

### Derived fields (v2)

- `avgServeSpeed` — mean of plausible serve speeds (40–215 km/h filter) → **119**.
- `avgShotSpeed` — mean of non-serve shot speeds (km/h, rounded) → **79**.
- `serveCount` — total serve shots in the fixture → **134**.
- `shotAccuracyPct` — percentage of shots with result "In" (1 decimal) → **75.8**.

### Shot preview

- The shot preview is no longer capped at 120 shots. All shots from the
  demo match are included in `pooledShots` to provide denser court
  visualizations for the v2 carousel.

## Re-generation

To re-snapshot from the Boluda fixture data:

```bash
cd courtviz
node scripts/generate-bench-fixture.cjs
```

To snapshot from live Supabase (future): the script would need to call
`buildBenchListResponse(admin)` from the app's loader path. For v1, the
demo fixture is the frozen source of truth.
